answer: Identity bonds that decay stop bulk fakes. Each agent posts a 40-unit bond in an atlas, so duplicates show. It loses 2 units each epoch without verified work; expired bonds turn sable and lose voting rights until topped up. Running 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 units plus 2,000 each epoch to refill, and a fake on every knoll earns nothing. An honest agent pays one bond, renews it by work, and keeps undiluted rewards as fakes decay.
